_comment: Identifies this project's PRODUCT: the discriminant every neoize graph node carries, so one shared Neo4j server holds many products without them colliding. A product can span several repos; give each repo's .neoize/project.json the same product id and they contribute to one graph. Copy to .neoize/project.json, set the id (lowercase, stable) and version-control it. `neoize product --set <id>` writes it for you. If this file is absent the product defaults to the git repo name, which is fine for a single-repo product.
